name: Martial Arts / Karate
intro: Dojos need recurring billing, attendance, and belt and rank tracking tied to promotion. These are the tools we track.

name: BJJ & MMA
intro: BJJ and MMA gyms need stripe and belt tracking, class check-in and simple memberships.

name: Dance Studio
intro: Dance studios need class registration, family accounts, recurring tuition and booking.

name: Yoga Studio
intro: Yoga studios need class booking, class packs and memberships, and drop-in payments.

name: Music Lesson Studios
intro: Private piano, voice and instrument teachers and small music schools need recurring lesson scheduling, make-ups, automatic invoicing or autopay, and a way for parents to see schedules and pay.
